title: Free Flow Fitness Party Request Form
description:
Thank you for contacting Free Flow Fitness! 

Party requests are answered in order, as soon as possible. The price covers up to 7 people for parties and private classes. In the event that a reschedule is needed, please contact us at info@freeflowfitnessstl.com or 314-625-2323 to make arrangements on a case-by-case basis.

Once party details are agreed upon, we'll send you an invoice via PayPal.

**Deposit is required to confirm your event and reserve your time slot. Deposits are non-refundable.

sections.title: Fab Flow Party
sections.description:
The Fab Flow Party is 90 minute party broken up into 60 minutes of activities/dancing and 30 minutes of mixing and mingling. 

$300 for up to 7 people. $25 for each additional person up to 15 total people (if more than 15 people, select a 2 hour party). 

Includes a gift for your guest of honor.

Non-Refundable deposit of $150.00

sections.title: Private Group Class
sections.description:
A 60 minute private pole class that reflects our Level 1 Pole class. In our Level 1 Pole class, you will go through a warm-up and learn foundational pole moves such as step arounds, body waves, basic spins, and basic sits.

$225 for 7 people. $25 for each additional guest up to 14 people total.

Non-Refundable deposit of $112.50.

sections.title: Body Painting
sections.description:
The Body Painting private event is approximately 2 hours long, but may take longer depending on number of people participating.

$300 for 4 people. $70 for each additional person up to 10 total people.

Non-Refundable deposit of $150

Each individual will be provided with a 24"x36" canvas (choice of white or black), paint, and brushes. 
Individuals may use their booty or chest to paint with.
